title: What if India's population doubled to 2.8 billion? 👥
description:
What if India's population doubled to 2.8 billion people?

India already has more than 1.4 billion people. Doubling that would mean twice the rice, wheat and vegetables on the same land, plus far more water, homes, jobs and electricity. Cities would grow into each other, and roads, schools and hospitals would need to double just to keep today's standard.

📌 Quick facts
• India has about 1.4 billion people, the most of any country (UN World Population Prospects 2024)
Figures are approximate and rounded.
